ValidationRule.description: FM Notes required when any inspection score is 3 or below
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), (AND( OR( Score_Sod_Install__c <= 3, Score_Sod_Health__c <= 3, Score_Plant_Install__c <= 3, Score_Plant_Health__c <= 3, Score_Cleanup__c <= 3, Score_Site_Condition__c <= 3, Score_Overall__c <= 3 ), ISBLANK(FM_Notes__c) )) )
